stories.title: Follow live: Guardians chase Sox starter, score on throwing error
NFL suspends 2 officials for conduct toward players
stories.summary: The NFL has suspended line judge Jeff Seeman for two games for appearing to swear at Cardinals tight end Trey McBride. Referee Adrian Hill has been suspended one game for a separate incident in the Vikings' win over the Dolphins.

stories.title: 'Times fly': Capitals' Ovechkin to retire at end of season
stories.summary: Washington Capitals star Alex Ovechkin announced Monday that this will be his final season in the NHL.

stories.title: Ravens 'don't know the chances yet' whether Lamar will play on SNF
stories.summary: The Ravens are uncertain whether quarterback Lamar Jackson will play Sunday night against the Falcons.

stories.title: Sources: Chiefs WR Thornton (ankle) expected back in 12-16 weeks
stories.summary: Chiefs wide receiver Tyquan Thornton is expected back from a dislocated left ankle injury within 12 to 16 weeks, sources told NFL Network.
